records.headline: Rain Moderate warning for the wilaya: Jijel
records.description: Rain showers that may cause localized flooding.
records.instruction: Exercise caution. Avoid areas prone to flooding.

records.headline: Thunderstorm Moderate warning for the wilaya: Jijel
records.description: Locally active thunderstorms with gusts, brief heavy rain or moderate electrical activity.
records.instruction: Remain vigilant. Avoid exposed activities. Stay away from metal objects and power lines.
